title: Combination Sum
summary: List all distinct bags of candidate numbers whose sum is target.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–30 distinct candidates in [2, 40]. Target is in [1, 40]. There are fewer than 150 answers.
contractDetails.output-checking: Require every distinct answer once. The outer order and element order within each answer are free.

statement: List all distinct bags of candidate numbers whose sum is target. Each candidate can be used any number of times. Order does not distinguish answers.

examples.explanation: Either five twos or two fives reach ten.
The target can be made by one number or two.

constraints: 1–30 distinct candidates in [2, 40]. Target is in [1, 40]. There are fewer than 150 answers.
hints: Conceptual: Each positive number reduces the remaining target.
Directional: Use candidate indices to visit each combination in one order.
Implementation: After choosing a value, recurse from the same index to allow reuse. Save the path when the remainder reaches zero.
complexityAnalysis: O(c^d·(d+1)) time as a loose upper bound for c candidates and d = floor(target/minimum candidate). O(c+d) auxiliary space for a sorted copy and recursion.
